description.value:
Developed by a team of scientists who experienced a Swarm attack firsthand, this augmentation is inspired by how they appropriated resources from the worlds they despoiled. The despoiler maw is implanted in the back of your throat and allows you to expel thick, noxious acid, then harvest the smoke left behind by its victims into raw materials.

Activate—Spew Acid 2 (acid, magical)

Frequency twice per day

Effect You exhale a torrent of acid in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15]. Creatures and objects in the area take @Damage[10d6[acid]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:37|basic] save). For each living creature you damage this way, you generate one tube of a bland nutritional paste that contains enough nutrition to function as sustenance for a day. If you damage at least one object or nonliving creature, you can spend 1 minute to gather a number of UPBs equal to the damage dealt.
